4	# Read the optional Idempotency-Key header first. If it matches a create that already
5	# completed, short-circuit with a 200 returning the original owner (via IdempotentReplayException)
6	# instead of creating a duplicate; otherwise publish the key for recordIdempotency to pin after
7	# the create succeeds. Runs before the body is bound, so a replay does no work.
8	checkIdempotency:
9	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
10	  next: normalize
11	
12	# Normalize the telephone (strip non-digits, require exactly 10) first: it is the sole
13	# @RequestBody binding and must run before the DTO's digits-only pattern check would reject
14	# the raw input. It publishes the normalized body for the validate step.
15	normalize:
16	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
17	  next: normalizeEmail
18	
19	# Normalize the optional email (validate its format when present, then lower-case it) on the
20	# already-bound body, before validation and any persistence.
21	normalizeEmail:
22	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
23	  next: validateEmailDomain

25	# Reject an owner whose (now normalized) email domain is on the disposable-domain blocklist
26	# with a 400, before validation and any persistence. An absent email is skipped.
27	validateEmailDomain:
28	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerEmailDomain
29	  next: normalizeAddress
30	
31	# Normalize the address (trim/collapse whitespace, upper-case, expand abbreviations) on the
32	# already-bound body, before validation. Running before validate means an address blank once
33	# normalized is rejected as a missing required field, and every later address comparison
34	# (duplicate household, shared household id) sees the normalized form.
35	normalizeAddress:
36	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
37	  next: validate
38	
39	# Validate so a missing/blank required field is a 400 listing those fields, before any
40	# entity is built or persisted.
41	validate:
42	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
43	  next: validatePostcode
44	
45	# Validate the optional postcode when present: it must be valid for the city's region per the
46	# fixed ranges, else a 400. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode; an absent
47	# postcode is skipped. Runs after field validation (which enforces the 4-digit format) and
48	# before any entity is built or persisted.
49	validatePostcode:
50	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerPostcode
51	  next: validateRegistrationDate
52	
53	# Reject a supplied registrationDate later than the server's current date with a 400, before
54	# any entity is built or persisted. An absent date is left to default downstream. Runs after
55	# the other field validations and before the date is resolved (weekend-adjusted).
56	validateRegistrationDate:
57	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerRegistrationDate
58	  next: unique
59	
60	# Reject a request whose identity key (normalized telephone + lower-cased email +
61	# soundex(lastName)) already belongs to an existing owner with a 409, before any entity is
62	# built or persisted. The email-domain blocklist ran earlier. A soft-deleted owner is ignored.
63	# Reads the same transaction as the writes.
64	unique:
65	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureUniqueOwnerIdentity
66	  govern: [ transaction ]
67	  next: cityCapacity
68

70	# before any entity is built or persisted. Reads the count in the same transaction as the
71	# writes so the per-city cap is enforced consistently.

73	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureCityHasCapacity
74	  govern: [ transaction ]
75	  next: resolveRegistrationDate
76	
77	# Resolve the effective registration date (supplied date, else the server's current date)
78	# and roll a weekend forward to the next Monday, before the daily-capacity check counts
79	# against it and before the owner is built. Publishes the adjusted date for both.
80	resolveRegistrationDate:
81	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveOwnerRegistrationDate
82	  next: dailyCapacity
83	
84	# Reject the request with a 429 once the resolved business day (by adjusted registrationDate)

88	dailyCapacity:

95	  govern: [ transaction ]

98	# Stamp the deterministic household id (first 12 hex of SHA-256 of lastName + postcode) onto the

100	assignHousehold:
101	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHousehold
102	  govern: [ transaction ]
103	  next: assignHouseholdSize
104	
105	# Record the size of this owner's household once the create completes (existing members
106	# sharing its household id plus the owner itself). Runs after the household id is assigned,
107	# before the new owner is persisted, so the count reflects the state after the create without
108	# counting the owner twice.
109	assignHouseholdSize:
110	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerHouseholdSize
111	  govern: [ transaction ]
112	  next: assignNamesakeCount
113	
114	# Record how many existing owners already shared this owner's firstName and lastName
115	# (case-insensitively) before this create. Reads the count in the same transaction as the
116	# write, before the new owner is persisted so it is not counted against itself.

118	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerNamesakeCount
119	  govern: [ transaction ]
120	  next: assignMembershipPoints

128	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipPoints

136	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerMembershipLevel

142	# the household. With no existing household member no cap applies. Reads existing owners in the
143	# same transaction as the write, before the new owner is persisted so it is not counted against

146	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapOwnerMembershipLevel

154	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerBulkSignupWarning

156	  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

160	# upstream). A declared household member ('sharesHousehold') is never flagged. Reads existing
161	# owners in the same transaction as the write, before the new owner is persisted so it is not

163	assignPossibleDuplicate:
164	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignOwnerPossibleDuplicate
165	  govern: [ transaction ]
166	  next: applyRegistrationDate

169	# persisted, so it and every value derived from it use the adjusted business day.
170	applyRegistrationDate:
171	  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplyOwnerRegistrationDate
172	  govern: [ transaction ]
173	  next: assignCustomerCode

175	# Assign the '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code: the owner's region (derived from its postcode)

178	assignCustomerCode:

## Overview

The repo is an OfficeFloor/Spring PetClinic ("PetClinic-Evolve") variant. Owner creation is driven by a single OfficeFloor REST pipeline (`POST /api/owners`) declared in a YAML file, whose steps map to individual function classes under `.../rest/function/owner/`. Auditing is one step in that pipeline (`AuditOwnerCreated`) that logs to a dedicated `AUDIT` SLF4J logger.

Note one load-bearing discrepancy I found between the audit implementation and the test — flagged at the end.

---

## 1. The create-owner pipeline YAML

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners.POST.yml`

This is the full orchestration (quoted verbatim above). The step order is:
`checkIdempotency → normalize → normalizeEmail → validateEmailDomain → normalizeAddress → validate → validatePostcode → validateRegistrationDate → unique → cityCapacity → resolveRegistrationDate → dailyCapacity → build → assignHousehold → assignHouseholdSize → assignNamesakeCount → assignMembershipPoints → assignMembershipLevel → capMembershipLevel → assignBulkSignupWarning → assignPossibleDuplicate → applyRegistrationDate → assignCustomerCode → save → recordIdempotency → audit → respond`.

Top of file: `composition: authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"`. Steps from `unique` onward run under `govern: [ transaction ]`.

The audit + respond tail (lines 196-206):
```yaml

respond:
```
